Lurt 0.8.8 gives every tab its own volume, and fixes missing site icons.

**Download Lurt:** [Windows (lurt.exe)](https://github.com/ladroxd/Lurt/releases/download/v0.8.8/lurt.exe) · [SHA-256 checksum](https://github.com/ladroxd/Lurt/releases/download/v0.8.8/lurt.exe.sha256)

No installer: download it and run it. Windows may show a SmartScreen warning because the app isn't signed; choose **More info → Run anyway**. Needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which Windows 10 and 11 already include.

## New

- **Tab volume.** A speaker appears on tabs that play sound; click it to mute. The toolbar speaker opens a mixer with a slider for each of those tabs, on top of the site's own volume.

## Fixed

- **Site icons.** Sites like Discord showed a colored letter instead of their icon on the bookmarks bar, on restored tabs, and in history, suggestions and favourites.
